title: CVE-2020-9829
impact: Processing a maliciously crafted text message may lead to application denial of service.

title: Internal Files Published
impact: Internal Apple files were published online which exposed confidential information.

title: Internal Staging Environment Exposed
impact: Apple's privacy policy linked to a PDF which contained information regarding an internal staging environment.

title: Exposed Employee Credentials & Confidential Documents
impact: Multiple Apple contractor credentials were publicly exposed online, potentially granting unauthorized access to confidential information. Furthermore, confidential documents were discovered stored with inadequate security measures.

title: Improper Dashboard Access
impact: Visiting the affected site temporarily exposed confidential dashboard content before redirecting to the authentication page.

title: Exposed Employee Credentials
impact: Two Apple contractor credentials were publicly exposed online, potentially granting access to confidential information.

title: iCloud Credential Dump
impact: A leaked database of roughly one million iCloud account credentials was discovered and reported to Apple Product Security, who confirmed they were taking appropriate action.

title: Gmail Credential Dump
impact: A leaked database of roughly 92 million Gmail account credentials was discovered and reported to Google; affected users whose current password matched the leaked credentials were forced to reset it.
